_comment: Field-help text for the elevation surfaces, same physical-height defect as the nav and pages batches: 海拔 (sea-level altitude) and 高程 (survey elevation) standing in for privilege elevation. elevationTemplateEnabled additionally shipped a truncated identifier -- levation_secret, missing its leading e -- which is worse than a mistranslation because an operator copying that string into settings.json gets a key the server does not read. Identifiers stay Latin and exact. Corrected to 提升權限 to match 取得提升代碼 elsewhere in this pack. AGENT DRAFTS -- native review still required.

source.elevationTemplateEnabled: When enabled, settings.json issued for this group includes elevation_secret so operators can mint elevation codes.
source.elevationDuration: Minutes the elevation stays active after activation (1–480).
source.elevationResponse: Computed challenge response to paste back into the elevation client.
source.elevationActivateImmediately: When on, the elevation applies as soon as the agent accepts the code.
source.elevationMockEndpoint: Demo endpoint name shown in this elevation mock panel.
source.elevationMintScope: Scope offered when minting an elevation activation code (mock).
source.elevationPolicyMock: Demo elevation policy field for this mock panel.

zh-TW.elevationTemplateEnabled: 啟用後，為此群組發布的 settings.json 會包含 elevation_secret，以便操作員可以鑄造提升權限代碼。
zh-TW.elevationDuration: 啟動後提升權限保持作用中的分鐘數 (1–480)。
zh-TW.elevationResponse: 計算出的質詢回應，貼回提升權限用戶端。
zh-TW.elevationActivateImmediately: 啟用後，一旦代理程式接受代碼，就會套用提升權限。
zh-TW.elevationMockEndpoint: 此提升權限模擬面板中顯示的示範端點名稱。
zh-TW.elevationMintScope: 鑄造提升權限啟用代碼（模擬）時提供的範圍。
zh-TW.elevationPolicyMock: 此模擬面板的示範提升權限政策欄位。
